### Stay in Circulation - Today's Insight - August 11, 2022
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-11-2022.html
Passage: Jeremiah 12:5
Points:
- Gathering with fellow believers on Sunday is a comfortable privilege, not a major sacrifice.
- The genuine test of Christian faith occurs amid the routine pressures and friction of the workweek.
- Jeremiah 12:5 challenges believers that if small everyday struggles exhaust us, we will never endure harder trials.
- Real faith cannot remain safely insulated like polished cathedral statues; it must be put into active circulation in the world.
- Spiritual warfare in secular environments demands grit, discipline, and a refusal to surrender under pressure.
